latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing with AI Voice.

- Instantly replace original voice-overs in video files with natural-sounding AI voice in American English.
- Automatically trims pauses and cleans up audio without professional editing software.
- Supports video uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM); fast turnaround (1–2 minutes for short clips).
- No installation needed—uses secure remote GPU nodes for all processing.
- Simple workflow: upload video, describe desired edits, and receive a polished MP4 download.
- Includes session management, credit tracking, and export management for multiple or iterative video projects.
